statement: Let P(i) = sum_{j=0}^{i} nums[j] and S(i) = sum_{j=i}^{n-1} nums[j] for 0 <= i < n. The function returns a result r and r = max_{0 <= i < n} max(P(i), S(i)).
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r and does not fail (no panic, out-of-bounds access, or i64 overflow). In particular, every prefix sum sum_{j=0}^{i} nums[j], every suffix sum sum_{j=i}^{n-1} nums[j], and the returned value r lie in the i64 range.
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 100000.

statement: Let P(i) = sum_{j=0}^{i} nums[j] for 0 <= i < n. The function returns a result r and for every i with 0 <= i < n, r >= P(i).
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 100000.

statement: Let S(i) = sum_{j=i}^{n-1} nums[j] for 0 <= i < n. The function returns a result r and for every i with 0 <= i < n, r >= S(i).
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 100000.

statement: Let P(i) = sum_{j=0}^{i} nums[j] and S(i) = sum_{j=i}^{n-1} nums[j] for 0 <= i < n. The function returns a result r and there exists an index i with 0 <= i < n such that r = max(P(i), S(i)).
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 100000.

statement: Let P(i) = sum_{j=0}^{i} nums[j] and S(i) = sum_{j=i}^{n-1} nums[j] for 0 <= i < n. The function returns a result r and r is equal to P(i) for some i with 0 <= i < n, or r is equal to S(i) for some i with 0 <= i < n.
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 100000.

statement: Let pos = sum_{j=0}^{n-1} max(nums[j], 0). The function returns a result r and r <= pos.
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 100000.

statement: Let total = sum_{j=0}^{n-1} nums[j]. The function returns a result r and r = total.
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, 0 <= nums[j] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = max(nums[0], nums[n-1]).
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 0.

statement: Let P(i) = sum_{j=0}^{i} nums[j] and S(i) = sum_{j=i}^{n-1} nums[j] for 0 <= i < n. The function returns a result r and r = max( max_{0 <= i < n} P(i), max_{0 <= i < n} S(i) ).
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r on nums. For every slice nums2 such that len(nums2) = n and for every j with 0 <= j < n, nums[j] <= nums2[j] and -100000 <= nums2[j] <= 100000, whenever the function on nums2 returns r2, we have r <= r2.
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r on nums. Let rev be the slice with len(rev) = n and rev[i] = nums[n-1-i] for 0 <= i < n. Whenever the function on rev returns r_rev, we have r = r_rev.
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every j with 0 <= j < n, -100000 <= nums[j] <= 100000.
